title: Constant-coefficient projection for compact support
statement: For a noetherian commutative ring R, a compactification c whose compact-support direct image preserves all small discrete coproducts, a source complex K, and a coefficient complex M, the proper projection map at the open extension of K and the constant sheaf of M is an isomorphism.

source.place: projection formula and generation by free coefficient complexes, Tags 07A4 and 0G7E

proof.text: View both sides as exact triangulated coproduct-preserving functors of M. The projection map is invertible on the regular module by the unit computation, and the derived module category is generated by shifts, coproducts, triangles and retracts of the regular module.

proof_origin: Reduced to localizing generation by the regular module.

lean.statement: theorem isIso_constantSupportProjection (R₀ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R₀] [IsNoetherianRing R₀] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f) [∀ I : Type (u + 1), PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R₀) c)] (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R₀))) (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R₀)) : IsIso (((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R₀) c.g).app ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R₀) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)).app ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R₀)).mapDerivedCategory.obj M))
